title: Jesus warned us clearly: deception would come through false prophets. Not every voice behind a pulpit speaks for God.
paragraphs: Jesus warned us clearly: deception would come through false prophets. Not every voice behind a pulpit speaks for God.

The question is not “Are they popular?”
The question is “Are they preaching truth?”
Just because someone has a microphone, a big church, or millions of followers doesn't mean God sent them.
Jesus literally warned us about this.
How do you personally tell the difference between a true preacher and a false one? 👇
